_brief: Batch 2026-10-03 item 9, Kindness Tests: Shop owner 5 (a juice stand in the Old City, Mohammed). V1. Shape: who they are (I am Jewish / We are brothers, bro. One God) -> the ASK -> THE YES -> the giving seen -> THE WHY (It is not helping. We are brothers) -> REVEAL -> REFUSAL held on his face -> said again in the two-shot -> handshake -> slow-mo: Tal walks off drinking the juice. NO ZOOMS (LESSONS 80): every beat is one constant framing. Cameras: VID_..037 = chest cam POV (his face from 54s on; before that only his torso, so the opening is iPhone), IMG_8325 = iPhone observer, both men in frame. Sound: chest cam throughout (iPhone = POV - 2.68s, align-cameras 0.562, confirmed on "Actually, I'll be honest": 67.6 / 70.28).
_framing: Every iPhone beat uses ONE static 1.2 framing with the window against the RIGHT edge (x 0.167-1.0). Reason: a boy with a ball stands at the left edge of the iPhone frame from 21.0s to past 24s (LESSONS 81: children who are strangers get blurred - here he is simply outside the frame; checked on 7 crops across 17.1-23.6, he is in none). The last beat uses the same size against the LEFT edge so Tal walking is whole; no child is in frame at 112-114.
_left_out: 45-53s: he first says the stand is not his ("It's not for me. He's my cousin") and Tal asks twice more - left out, the yes is what matters. 119s on is Tal and his crew talking about the test - never used.
